terms.gloss: fish as food, a catch of fish
terms.comment: Properly “a fishing”; in comedy also the fish themselves, as food (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Quid est in ventre piscis, tata?
phrases.english: What’s in the fish’s belly, Dad?

phrases.latin: «In hōc pisce ānulus nōn est, tata.»
phrases.english: “There’s no ring in this fish, Dad.”

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 71.
